"""Contract tests for SQL connections 8/10 semantic READ_ONLY ingress."""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from modules.worker_ingress import semantic_capabilities as sem_caps
from modules.worker_ingress import service


USER = {"id": "1", "email": "ricardo@edarsa.com.mx", "role": "SuperAdministrador"}
EXPECTED_PATHS = [
    "backend/core/centro_control/routes.py",
    "backend/core/config/edarsahub_config.py",
    "backend/core/sql_first/connection_factory.py",
    "backend/core/sql_first/db.py",
    "backend/core/connections/hrlectura_connection_factory.py",
    "backend/server.py",
]


def _request(**overrides):
    payload = {
        "objective": "Auditar conexiones SQL 8/10 sin leer secretos ni modificar Produccion.",
        "bounded_context": "SQL_CONNECTIONS_8OF10",
        "mode": "READ_ONLY",
        "capability": "SQL_CONNECTIONS_BOOTSTRAP_READONLY",
        "constraints": {},
        "request_key": "SQL8-TEST-R1",
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


def test_registered_and_catalogued():
    assert "SQL_CONNECTIONS_BOOTSTRAP_READONLY" in sem_caps.registered_capabilities()
    entry = {x["code"]: x for x in sem_caps.capability_catalog()}["SQL_CONNECTIONS_BOOTSTRAP_READONLY"]
    assert entry["modes"] == ["READ_ONLY"]
    assert entry["bounded_context_rule"] == "SQL_CONNECTIONS_8OF10"
    assert entry["allowed_constraints"] == []
    assert entry["raw_worker_fields_forbidden"] is True


def test_expands_fixed_readonly_contract():
    job = service.build_semantic_job(_request(), current_user=USER)
    assert job["mode"] == "READ_ONLY"
    assert job["production_allowed"] is False
    assert job["actions"] == []
    assert job["target_repo"] == "rbalam/EDARSA_HUB"
    assert job["target_branch"] == "Edarsahub_Desarrollo"
    check = job["checks"][0]
    assert check["type"] == "repository_contract_audit"
    assert check["request"]["paths"] == EXPECTED_PATHS
    assert check["request"]["max_results"] == 200


def test_rejects_other_context():
    with pytest.raises(service.WorkerIngressError, match="SEMANTIC_BOUNDED_CONTEXT_UNSUPPORTED"):
        service.build_semantic_job(_request(bounded_context="OTHER_DOMAIN"), current_user=USER)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("constraints", [
    {"paths": ["backend/core"]},
    {"actions": []},
    {"checks": [{"type": "git_diff_check"}]},
    {"production_allowed": False},
    {"search_terms": ["password"]},
])
def test_rejects_caller_constraints(constraints):
    with pytest.raises(service.WorkerIngressError, match="SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_UNSUPPORTED"):
        service.build_semantic_job(_request(constraints=constraints), current_user=USER)


def test_submission_reuses_canonical_publisher(monkeypatch):
    captured = {}
    def fake_submit(job, *, remote="origin", queue_branch="worker/requests", require_convergence=False):
        captured.update(job=job, remote=remote, queue_branch=queue_branch, require_convergence=require_convergence)
        return {"status": "SUBMITTED", "job_id": job["job_id"], "production_touched": False}
    monkeypatch.setattr(service.gate_chain_publisher, "submit", fake_submit)
    result = service.submit_objective(_request(), current_user=USER)
    assert result["status"] == "SUBMITTED"
    assert result["production_touched"] is False
    assert result["capability"] == "SQL_CONNECTIONS_BOOTSTRAP_READONLY"
    assert captured["job"]["actions"] == []
    assert captured["job"]["production_allowed"] is False
    assert captured["remote"] == "origin"
    assert captured["queue_branch"] == "worker/requests"
    assert captured["require_convergence"] is False

objective: Registrar atomica y fail-closed la capability SQL_CONNECTIONS_BOOTSTRAP_READONLY y su contrato/test para continuar SQL connections 8/10 por Universal Worker v4. Sin Produccion, secretos, SQL, Supervisor ni MongoDB.
